{{/* Form Select Component - renders dropdown select fields with consistent styling Updated for Stratus Design System Parameters: - name (required): Select name attribute - id (optional): HTML id attribute (default: same as name) - label (optional): Label text to display above select - placeholder (optional): Placeholder option text (e.g., "Select an option...") - required (optional): Whether field is required (default: false) - disabled (optional): Whether field is disabled (default: false) - helpText (optional): Help text to display below select - onchange (optional): JavaScript onchange handler - class (optional): Additional CSS classes for the select - containerClass (optional): Additional CSS classes for the container div Note: Options should be rendered separately in the calling template using standard
